sentences: Loop 3 baar chalega aur har baar swap hoga, toh array sort ho jayega.
a[j] > a[j+1] check karke swap kiya, isliye chhote elements aage aa gaye.
Har comparison mein bada element aage jayega, toh poora array arrange ho jayega.
j 0 se 2 tak gaya aur har pair swap hua, isliye 1,2,3,4 mila.
Swap function se elements apni sahi jagah pe aa gaye, bas ek hi pass mein.
